data.title: Checkout errors increased after a production change
data.customer_impact: Checkout completion rate is below the 99% service objective; customer-facing errors are active.
data.operator_note: A dashboard note suggests a recent traffic increase may be involved.
data.objective: Restore checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and critical services to healthy state.

payload.plan: AgentPlan(hypothesis='The recent production change introduced a regression in payment-service that increases checkout errors and latency, possibly due to a misconfigured dependency or resource contention.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Collect and analyze payment-service logs for error patterns and stack traces during the incident window.', success_signal='Logs show a consistent increase in specific error codes (e.g., 502, 504) and stack traces pointing to the new code path introduced in the latest deployment.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Retrieve and compare payment-service latency metrics (p95) before and after the change, and correlate with traffic volume.', success_signal='Latency metrics confirm a spike above 800\u202fms coinciding with the deployment and traffic increase.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Inspect tracing data to identify bottlenecks or failed downstream calls (e.g., database, external payment gateway).', success_signal='Tracing reveals a high failure rate or timeout in a downstream service that payment-service calls.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S4', objective='Validate that the suspected regression is isolated to the new deployment by rolling back the last change in a staging environment and re‑testing checkout flow.', success_signal='Rollback restores error rate and latency to baseline levels.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S5', objective='If rollback fixes the issue, coordinate a hotfix or revert the problematic code path, ensuring no new regressions are introduced.', success_signal='Hotfix deployment completes without new errors and metrics return to target thresholds.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S6', objective='Implement automated tests (unit, integration, contract) for the affected code path and add monitoring alerts for the identified error patterns.', success_signal='Tests pass locally and in CI; alerts trigger on error thresholds in production.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S7', objective='Post‑incident review: document root cause, remediation steps, and preventive controls; update runbooks and run a blameless post‑mortem.', success_signal='Incident report is completed, runbooks updated, and lessons learned shared with the team.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S8', objective='Verify that checkout success rate is ≥99% and p95 latency ≤800\u202fms for a sustained period (e.g., 30\u202fminutes) before closing the incident.', success_signal='Monitoring dashboards show sustained compliance with service objectives and no active errors.', status='pending')], revision=1, rationale_summary='The incident was triggered after a deployment, and the operator notes a traffic spike. The service objective is breached, and customer-facing errors are active. Objective evidence will come from logs, metrics, and tracing to confirm increased error rates and latency in payment-service, and to rule out unrelated traffic or external dependencies.')
